name: hubspot-mcp
description: HubSpot CRM MCP server (protocol 2026-07-28) — 79 domain tools + write-safety preview/approve gate with risk-tiered approval, pattern approval, undo snapshots and audit log, plus 44 specialist charters as MCP prompts. Bring-your-own-app OAuth.

hubspot_client_id.title: HubSpot Client ID
hubspot_client_id.description: HubSpot app Client ID (find it in your app's Auth tab in the HubSpot developer portal).

hubspot_client_secret.title: HubSpot Client Secret
hubspot_client_secret.description: HubSpot app Client Secret (same Auth tab). Stored in your OS keychain and written to ~/.claude/hubspot/app_credentials.json (chmod 600); only ever sent to HubSpot's token endpoint.

hubspot_portal_id.title: HubSpot Portal ID
hubspot_portal_id.description: The HubSpot portal (hub) ID the server should operate on.

hubspot_region.title: HubSpot Region
hubspot_region.description: App region: 'us' (default) or 'eu'. Use 'eu' only if your app was created in the EU developer portal.
